notes: 7 web searches ran, none refused. No direct quote by Shah on AI was found. Paraphrases only (not quotes): KJZZ, 8 October 2026 (https://www.kjzz.org/politics/2026-10-08/arizona-1st-congressional-district-candidates-share-different-views-on-data-centers-in-debate), reports that in the 7 October 2026 debate with Jay Feely he said he now opposes the data center tax credit he voted for in 2021, that the AI boom had not happened then, and that data centers belong in communities that want them; KTAR (https://ktar.com/arizona-politics-news/amish-shah-jay-feely-cd1-debate) reports he opposes data centers in the district over water. As a non-member he could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; no House-letter or other record found. Several search results concerned other people named Shah (Chirag Shah, Rohin Shah) and were ignored. If the reviewer considers data-center opposition not to be 'about AI', the grade should be 'none'.
